name: London
meta_description: London brewery tours, beer tastings and historic pub walks — from the Bermondsey Beer Mile to centuries-old taverns. Compare top-rated experiences.
intro_md:
London's beer story runs from coaching inns that served Dickens to railway-arch taprooms pouring hazy pale ales. The best-known modern chapter is the Bermondsey Beer Mile, a string of breweries and taprooms tucked beneath the railway arches south of Tower Bridge — pair it with a wander through Borough Market, one of the capital's oldest food markets, just up the road.

The City and Fleet Street keep the historic end of things alive, with centuries-old taverns like Ye Olde Cheshire Cheese hidden down narrow alleys, while Camden and Hackney anchor the craft scene in the north and east. Wherever you end up, the pub remains the point: settle in, order a pint of cask bitter, and take your time.

Don't miss:

- The Bermondsey Beer Mile's railway-arch taprooms (Saturdays are liveliest)
- Borough Market for a pre-tour lunch
- The historic pubs of Fleet Street and the City
- Camden Town's market and brewery taprooms

gyg_tours.title: London: Bermondsey Craft Brewery Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A guided walk along the Bermondsey Beer Mile, visiting four railway-arch taprooms with tutored tastings led by an international beer judge.
gyg_tours.description_md: This guided walking tour explores the craft breweries and taprooms of Bermondsey's famous 'Beer Mile' in London. Small groups of up to 14 people are led by a local guide to four taprooms, with visits drawn from breweries such as Southwark Brewing, Anspach and Hobday, Moor Beer, The Kernel, Bianca Road and the Barrel Project. Along the way guests receive tutored tastings of every beer, learning how to taste beer, alongside the history of the area and the different beer styles.
highlights: Walk the Bermondsey Beer Mile with a local guide
Tutored tastings of every beer sampled
Learn to taste beer like a pro
Guided by an international beer judge
Small groups of up to 14 people

gyg_tours.title: London: Historic Pubs of Central London Walking Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A guided walk of around two miles through central London, calling at four historic taverns — some dating back to the 16th century — with stories of the city's drinking culture along the way.
gyg_tours.description_md: A guided walk of around two miles through central London, calling at four historic taverns — some dating back to the sixteenth century. Along the way your guide brings the capitals drinking culture to life with stories of the writers, rogues and revolutionaries who once propped up these bars.
highlights: Around two miles of gentle walking

gyg_tours.title: London: Royal Historic Pubs Walking Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A walking tour of four tucked-away pubs near Buckingham Palace, pairing British beers with tales of Churchill, royalty and other national figures.
gyg_tours.description_md: This 2.5-hour guided walking tour explores four historic, tucked-away pubs in London's royal district. Along the way you sample traditional British beer while your local guide shares stories of figures such as Churchill and the Queen. The route takes in secret alleyways, ancient tunnels and royal landmarks, with tales of scandal, romance and intrigue.
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Piccadilly Circus, next to the winged statue in the centre; guide holds an open umbrella.

gyg_tours.title: 3 Locks Brewing Company: Guided tasting and brewery tour
gyg_tours.summary: A tour and tasting at an independent brewery in Camden Market, including six beers — some poured straight from the tank.
gyg_tours.description_md: Join a 1.5-hour guided tasting and brewery tour at 3 Locks Brewing Company, an independent brewery in London. You'll be taken through the brewhouse to learn about the brewing process while sampling a range of the brewery's beers, including some poured straight from the tank. The experience combines a friendly guided tasting flight with a behind-the-scenes look at how the beer is made.
highlights: Beer poured straight from the tank
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Check in with the bar team at 3 Locks Brewing Company

gyg_tours.title: London: Small Group, Ancient Pubs and Historic Taverns Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A small-group, two-hour walk through some of London's oldest pubs and taverns, combining beer tasting with centuries of local history. Non-drinkers are welcome.
gyg_tours.description_md:
This small-group guided walking tour leads you through some of London's most atmospheric pubs and historic taverns, several dating back to the 16th century. As you wind through cobbled streets, hidden courtyards and lesser-known corners of the city, your guide shares stories of the famous drinkers, criminals and local legends tied to each establishment. The experience combines historical storytelling with British ale tastings and an introduction to traditional pub culture. Participation in the drinking is entirely optional, so non-drinkers are equally welcome.</description_md>
<parameter name="meeting_point">Waterhouse Square, 1 Waterhouse Square, London. The guide holds a green sign reading "Side Routes".
highlights: Visit historic London pubs and taverns
Hear stories of famous drinkers and legends

gyg_tours.title: London: Full-Day English Wine Tour with Lunch
gyg_tours.summary: A full day from London Bridge visiting three award-winning English vineyards by coach, with guided tastings at each and a country lunch with a glass of English wine.
gyg_tours.description_md: Leave the city behind for a full day in English wine country. Travelling by comfortable coach from London Bridge, you'll visit three award-winning vineyards in the countryside south of the capital, with an expert guide sharing the story of England's fast-rising wine scene along the way. Each stop includes a guided tasting, and a traditional English lunch — with a glass of English wine — is served at a country pub. Water, snacks and a reusable goodie bag are included.
highlights: Visit and taste at three award-winning English vineyards
Expert guide on English wine history and production
Scenic countryside and quintessential English villages
Traditional lunch with a glass of English wine
Water, snacks and a reusable goodie bag included
gyg_tours.meeting_point: In front of the entrance to Southwark Crown Court, near London Bridge station

gyg_tours.title: London: Wine Tasting Bus Tour with a Sommelier
gyg_tours.summary: A 90-minute panoramic bus tour of London led by a sommelier, tasting four European wines paired with cheeses as you pass Big Ben and Tower Bridge.
gyg_tours.description_md: See London's landmarks and taste your way around Europe at the same time. Aboard a double-decker bus, a professional sommelier guides you through four carefully chosen wines, each paired with a complementary cheese, over a 90-minute panoramic loop past Big Ben, Tower Bridge and more. You'll vote on your favourite and take home a branded tasting card as a souvenir.
highlights: Four European wines paired with cheeses
Views of Big Ben, Tower Bridge and more
Take home a branded tasting card
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Golden Tours Bus Stop 1, Bulleid Way, London SW1W 9SR
